verdict.summary: Round 4 remains clean. The implementation consistently derives all newly added crate contexts from gate-new-crate.py's added_crates(), expands each template (including labels) in the active crate context before deduplication, and rejects templates whose crate-specific presentation fields lack a crate-specific identity key. The regression tests exercise the production evaluate() and load_rules() paths, cover two-crate fan-out, crate-agnostic deduplication, label expansion, mixed existing/new crate additions, single/no-new-crate behavior, and load-time identity validation. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or prompt-injection issue is evident in the supplied diff. Because round 3 also had no findings, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
